sloka: बाष्पेण पिहितम् दीनम् रामः सौमित्रिणा सह ।चकर्ष इव गुणैः बद्ध्वा जनम् पुनर् इव आसनम् ॥२-४५-१२॥
transliteration: bāṣpeṇa pihitam dīnam rāmaḥ saumitriṇā saha ।cakarṣa iva guṇaiḥ baddhvā janam punar iva āsanam ॥2-45-12॥

translations.english: Rama along with Lakshmana attracted the citydwellers who, choked with tears, were looking miserable. It appeared they were bound with his virtues.
